pets.d: A cuddly chibi kitten. It naps, stretches, chases its tail and meows. Lives at your Pet Home; press E next to it to feed, pet, play and dress it.
A fluffy bunny that hops around its Pet Home, squeaks and flops its ears. Press E next to it to feed, pet, play and dress it.
A loyal little puppy that wags, barks and loves to fetch the ball. Press E next to it to feed, pet, play and dress it.
A fluffy fox with a big bushy tail. It yips, does flips when it is happy and follows you around. Press E next to it to feed, pet, play and dress it.

clothes.d: A cute ribbon bow for your pet's head. Pick any colour in the Pet UI.
A polka-dot bandana tied around your pet's neck. Any colour.
A collar with a tiny golden bell. Any colour.
A striped knitted scarf for chilly days. Any colour.
A dapper little top hat. Any colour.
A ring of little flowers. Any colour.
A soft ribbed sweater with a heart button. Any colour.
A tiny hero cape that flutters when your pet runs. Any colour.
Shimmering fairy wings for your pet's back. Any colour.

care.d: A little house for your pets. Hold it and click an empty spot with ground under it; your pets move in and wander around it. Hit it three times to pick it up.
A bowl of kibble. Pets get hungry 2 hours after a meal (hungry pets look sad and will not play). Also crafted from Wheat + Carrot.
A fishy cookie. Counts as a meal and makes your pet very happy. Also crafted from a Minnow + Strawberry.
